meta.privacy: Public-safe aggregate. Synthetic work aliases only; raw work or event identifiers, titles, comments, names, contacts, payroll, banking and raw errors are excluded.
meta.decisionBoundary: InfoCenter is the sole dispatch and work-result source. This read-only summary does not assign, review, close, pay or infer capacity.
